stock.description: Guangdong Yueyun Transportation Company Limited operates as an investment holding enterprise, delivering a broad spectrum of integrated transportation and logistics solutions throughout the People's Republic of China. Its primary activities encompass road passenger services, including urban, public, and cross-border routes, complemented by the management of passenger and freight stations. The company also oversees expressway service zones and engages in the supply of construction materials. Furthermore, Guangdong Yueyun diversifies its revenue streams through services such as advertising, real estate leasing, property management, vehicle inspection and testing, and motor driver training. Additional offerings include material logistics, tourism, commercial ventures, hotel operations, and various business services. Founded in 1999, the company was formerly known as Guangdong Nan Yue Logistics Company Limited, rebranding to its current name in August 2013. This Hong Kong-based entity functions as a subsidiary of Guangdong Provincial Communication Group Company Limited.
